This app is smaller than a photo. If you like, you can support its development via Liberapay or GitHub Sponsors.

What does the app do?
It sets a different DNS server for your apps by starting a local VPN that only carries the DNS setting. Your traffic is not routed through it and nothing is logged.

Setup
1. Pick a DNS server (tap the card). Own servers are marked ★ and listed first; long-press one in the list to delete it.
2. Tap "Start VPN" and allow the VPN request once.
3. Optional: add the "SwitchDNS" tile to the quick settings.

Apps
Either all apps except the selected ones, or only the selected ones use the DNS server.

Network rules
Use on mobile data and/or Wi-Fi. On Wi-Fi login pages (train, hotel) the app pauses until you are logged in. A notification opens the Wi-Fi settings; tap the hotspot there to sign in.

Android Auto
While Android Auto is connected the app pauses, otherwise the connection to the car can fail.

Always on
"Start on device boot" or system VPN settings → SwitchDNS → "Always-on VPN". Leave "Block connections without VPN" off.

Save / load
The icons at the top store all settings (incl. own servers and app list) in a file and restore them, e.g. on a new phone.

Privacy
SwitchDNS only sets the DNS server. No traffic passes through the app, nothing is logged or sent anywhere. The DNS provider you choose sees which domains are looked up.

Updates
Once a day the app checks GitHub for a newer version and offers the download. The browser downloads it, tapping the file installs it; settings are kept. Switch it off below: "Check for updates on start".
Also lists apps and services without a launcher icon, e.g. Google Play services.
